summary: Adds a Search box to the Albums and Artists screens that searches the whole library on the server (new logged-in GET api/search/albums and api/search/artists, up to 100 results, optional favorites-only, scoped to what the user can see), with loading skeletons and 'No matching ...' empty states.

statements.why: New routes sit inside the auth group in routes/api.base.php; repository search scopes results by user via getMany(user:).

statements.text: There's now a default list filter result limit of 100.
The agent changed docs/usage/web-interface.md, a notes file (not code).
statements.why: Docs line about the new search box.

statements.text: AlbumListScreen.vue: it now shows "No matching albums."
statements.why: New empty state when a search finds nothing.

statements.text: ArtistListScreen.vue: it now shows "No matching artists."
statements.why: New empty state when a search finds nothing.

statements.text: The agent also changed ListFilter.vue, useScrollAwayHeader.ts, albumStore.ts and artistStore.ts, in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: The headline feature: the Albums and Artists screens get a new Search box that finds matches across the whole library (not just loaded items), showing at most 100 results.
Two new server addresses, api/search/albums and api/search/artists, for logged-in users only.
